mapper.select: select pno, price, pqty, pdelete, pfilename, pregdate, pmoddate, ptitle_ko, pcontent_ko, pcategory_ko from tbl_product where pdelete = 0 order by pno desc limit #{skip}, #{size}
select count(pno) from tbl_product where pno > 0 and pdelete = false
select p.pno, p.ptitle_ko, p.pfilename, p.pcontent_ko, p.price from tbl_product_popular pp left join tbl_product p on pp.pno = p.pno where p.pdelete = 0 order by ppno desc limit #{skip}, #{size}
